rationale: Checked 2026-09-27T03:18:08Z against PLAN §1/§6/§8, VERIFICATION G4/G5, SPEC-03 §1, SPEC-04 §4/§6/§7, STATE.json, LOG.md, all 16 evidence files, the two untracked visual-fix files, the harness sources (compare.mjs, functional/run.mjs, visual/run.mjs), the attempt-2 manifests and diff in .scratch, and the app code. I tried to refute each of the four decisions. (1) Parity residuals: I re-derived the decompositions myself rather than trusting the proposal: the '/' link diff is exactly 3-for-3, the sitemap diff is exactly 9 B-only / 0 A-only / 0 changed with every loc on www.growmax.io, A's sitemap has been the same 203-entry snapshot since the P1.3 baseline (newest lastmod 2026-09-21T04:59:16Z on both), the home page is posts.slice(0,4) and B's three posts have distinct createdAt values so the A1 C8 tie question does not arise, and 0ff5864 is an ancestor of d8c8b05 with only server-side M-series files differing, which makes the CSS and JS chunk differences a build-environment matter. The CSS analysis's own open item (26 tokens 'in tracked source but missing on B') dissolves on inspection: they are substring matches of variant-prefixed classes, and Tailwind v4 on Vercel scans every tracked file, so B cannot lack a rule for a class the app literally uses. The one gap is the '/' visibleTextHash: SPEC-04 §4 requires a unified text diff on every text-hash mismatch, but attempt 2 wrote none (needsTextDiff:true, manifests hold only hashes, no raw bodies kept); the surrounding evidence (identical h1s/title/description/JSON-LD/images, 172 post pages proving identical date rendering, 0.18-0.38 % full-page pixel diff) makes any other text difference implausible, but approval of that single entry is gated on producing the diff (C-A3-2). All four entries are A-side staleness or an invisible build-environment difference, pin both observed values, and fail again on any later change, so I approve them. (2) F9: the parser's two residual false-pass paths are contrived serializations the real app (iron-session destroy plus Next's cookie normalizer: growmax-admin=; Path=/; Max-Age=0) never emits, and the real Chromium corroboration (password from env, in-page POST logout, session isAdmin:false, no growmax-admin cookie in context.cookies()) is the browser cookie engine's own verdict for this exact deployment; F9 counts as passed for G5, with the hardening and its opus review as a hard gate before P6.2 and browser corroboration kept on. (3) P4.3: the amendment is a semantic reconciliation, not an exclusion; the reviewer's 31 real-inventory mutations, the verifier's fresh run (raw output empty:true, diffCount 0, ignored only _system on a, 27 'n' rows reconciled) and the independent pg_depend/app-grep proof that _system has no dependants all hold; --accept-pg-major 18 encodes A1 C2 exactly; G4 stands, with G6 6.4 required to check the JSON output because the tool's main guard can fail open under a symlink. (4) Visual: the gate's literal criteria already pass (20/20 <= 0.5 %, 0 new console errors, 0 new error responses); the failed-request false positive is a harness classification bug confirmed by independent reproduction on both origins, and the working-tree fix keys third-party failures by origin+path+failure and first-party ones by path+search+failure with an 8-case offline self-test; no objection, subject to a short opus review and a clean re-run written as P5.2-visual.json. Nothing decided here can lose data, cause downtime or harm SEO: the allowlist covers cases where Vercel is the fresher, SEO-correct side, status codes, canonicals and redirects are identical across 297 URLs, and no evidence contains secrets or PII. Verdict GO_WITH_CONDITIONS: G5 can close once the allowlist is written under C-A3-1/2, the parity and visual evidence are regenerated by the verifier, and the F9 hardening, the staleness re-pin rule and the P6.4 data-loss guard are carried into A2.
